name: Suggested tasks
summary: Twice a weekday: scans the repos for security issues, production errors, slow endpoints, CI and test gaps, code health and dependency risk, and proposes fixes and bigger changes with evidence and a confidence. The Mate may start small ones by itself when seats are free; the launch card still waits for you.

onlyMine.label: Only code I mainly write (when the team pack splits findings by author); off: every finding, as colleagues may get too

repos.label: Repos to scan, by their names in the team pack (comma-separated; empty: all)

sources.label: What to look at: security, errors, perf, ci, tests, health, deps, backlog (comma-separated)

lookbackDays.label: Days of errors, commits and CI runs to read

autoStart.label: Let the Mate start small, confident fixes by itself when seats are free (never security ones; the launch card still waits for you)

autoStartPerDay.label: Most fixes the Mate starts by itself per day

autoStartUsagePct.label: Most of the weekly usage bar (%) those fixes may use
